d: From winning the Women's ODI World Cup and leading RCB to another WPL title to facing personal setbacks, Smriti Mandhana has had a year of highs and lows. Now, she takes over as India's captain after Harmanpreet Kaur's decade in charge. What does this new role mean for Mandhana and the future of Indian women's cricket? Rupha Ramani looks at her journey before India's era under Smriti Mandhana kicks off with a T20I against Zimbabwe.
